_what: The frozen panel-cover plan: one shared geometry and one entry per case. Compositing, generation, evaluation and the classifier's held-out set all read this file.
_frozen: 2026-11-05, from DECISIONS P7 and job 50283251. Nothing below was changed after any arm was generated.

geometry._crop_why: ffmpeg crop in source 1920x1080 pixels, 3:2 so the scale to 720x480 does not distort. It keeps the whole press, the cabinet door, the operator station and the floor in front, and drops only the roof structure above the press. The door occupies 2.22% of the preprocessed frame, which is small, and is the price of keeping the scene the labels describe.
geometry._polygon_frame: Preprocessed 720x480 coordinates, after the crop above and the scale by 720/1080 = 0.6667.
geometry._polygon_derivation: Not drawn by hand. The absolute difference between the two class means was smoothed over 5 px, thresholded at 20 of 255, and flooded from a seed inside the cabinet opening; the convex hull of that connected component was expanded 2 px outward from its centroid and mapped into preprocessed coordinates. 7667 px.
geometry._polygon_threshold_why: Three thresholds were rendered over both class means and compared. At 25 the region clipped the lower left of the door. At 15 and below the component merged with a second difference blob lower down, the wire-mesh guard that DECISIONS P5 wrongly identified, and the convex hull then filled the notch between them and covered scene that the labels are not about. 20 is the widest threshold that still separates the door from the guard.
geometry._polygon_covers: Checked against both class means: it contains the open cavity and the swung door leaf in the class-2 mean, and the closed cream door with its keypad in the class-6 mean. It excludes the blue parameter plate to its right, which is identical in both classes.
geometry._landmarks: x, y, w, h in the same preprocessed frame, in this order: the blue parameter plate right of the door; the sign block above it; the blue ram housing; the pallet and orange base left of the door; the yellow warning sign; the machine body below the plate. All six sit on fixed structure, none touches the mesh guard, and each was checked against the feathered mask for overlap before being frozen.
geometry._transform_why: Source and donor are the same fixed camera at the same pose, verified by an alignment correlation of at least 0.95 on a large static background patch. One degree of freedom per axis is what the situation contains; a higher-DOF fit would be free to warp the donor patch to absorb noise. Per-landmark residuals are written into every case record, so a translation that does not fit will show there rather than be hidden.

_segment_why: frame_step 3 on ~25 fps source gives 8.3 fps, played back at the checkpoint's 8 fps, so motion runs at roughly real speed. 49 frames at step 3 need 145 source frames, which is why every clip below is at least 149 frames long. start 0 in every case: no interval was searched for a flattering one.
_selection_why: Sources are the three best-separated class-2 clips that have at least 145 frames, a quiet panel region, and come from three different recording groups, so no two cases share footage. Donors are three different class-6 clips, also from different recording groups, so a donor artefact cannot repeat across all three cases unnoticed. Separation and activity figures come from job 50283251 and are recorded per case.

cases.intended_change: The electrical cabinet door on the press column is shut flat for the whole interval instead of standing open.
cases.must_not_change: The worker and what the worker is doing, the press and its tooling, the mesh guard, the scrap bin, the floor markings, the lighting and the camera pose.

_measured_caveat: The separation and activity figures above were measured against the scoring box [208, 614, 130, 164], which is a smaller rectangle inside the door. The composite region is the polygon derived afterwards. The figures rank the clips; they do not define the region.
_intervention: The primary intervention is a panel cover that is already closed throughout the selected interval. No door-closing motion is generated, and no case may be described as one.
_acceptance: The composite changes no pixel outside the feathered region.
The warped donor covers at least 0.999 of the feathered region.
Translation residuals stay below 2 px rms across the usable landmarks.
The source's own region is quiet over the interval: nothing walks through the area being replaced.
The seam step across the region boundary is of the same order as a control boundary in untouched scene.
